goal.statement: Prove the high-risk no-ICP architecture paths before migrating the remaining aivoice product: private HTTP Function identity, native media, stateless job recovery, and CloudBase-managed WeChat Pay callback.
success_criteria: Mini-program invokes the NestJS HTTP Function through wx.cloud.callHTTPFunction and backend receives platform identity
Authorized video and generated audio use native CloudBase file IDs with no custom domain
Immediate and timer Worker dispatch work without a resident API dispatcher
CloudBase-managed WeChat Pay callback applies the existing atomic +50 grant once
out_of_scope: migration of deterministic non-risk API calls and pages
